# TestScript for 14-multiformat-and-dotenv
# Asserts .env / .env.local loading (expansion, quotes, non-destruction),
# multi-format decoders (JSON, TOML, YAML, HCL), and typo suggestions

env HOME=$WORK/home
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/xdg

# 1. Automatic .env + .env.local loading into process environment
# (DATABASE_URL is expanded from DB_HOST; SERVICE_NAME is single-quoted; API_KEY comes from .env.local)
exec multiformat-app
stdout '⚙  multiformat-app'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+8000\s+● env PORT'
stdout '-d, --database-url\s+string\s+postgres://localhost:5432/db\s+● env DATABASE_URL'
stdout '--service-name\s+string\s+local svc\s+● env SERVICE_NAME'
stdout '--api-key\s+string\s+local-dev-key-42\s+● env API_KEY'

# 2. --why lists the registered decoders, the winning tier per flag, and
#    redacts the credential-bearing fields (DATABASE_URL, API_KEY)
exec multiformat-app --why
stdout 'Config decoders: \.hcl, \.json, \.toml, \.yaml, \.yml'
stdout '--service-name\s+local svc\s+env\s+SERVICE_NAME'
stdout '--database-url\s+██████\s+env'
stdout '--api-key\s+██████\s+env'
stdout 'values are redacted'

# 3. Real OS environment variables are never overwritten by .env files
env PORT=7777
exec multiformat-app
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+7777\s+● env PORT'
env PORT=

# Remove dotenv files and clear env vars to test pure multi-format config decoders
rm .env
rm .env.local
env -u DATABASE_URL
env -u SERVICE_NAME
env -u API_KEY

# 4. JSON config decoding
exec multiformat-app -c config.json
stdout '-c, --config-file\s+conga\.ConfigFile\s+config\.json\s+● cli --config-file'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+3000\s+● config config\.json'
stdout '--max-workers\s+int\s+8\s+● config config\.json'
stdout '--service-name\s+string\s+json-service\s+● config config\.json'

# 5. YAML config decoding (with snake_case and kebab-case normalization)
exec multiformat-app -c config.yaml
stdout '--service-name\s+string\s+yaml-service\s+● config config\.yaml'
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+4000\s+● config config\.yaml'

# 6. TOML config decoding
exec multiformat-app -c config.toml
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+5000\s+● config config\.toml'
stdout '--max-workers\s+int\s+16\s+● config config\.toml'

# 7. HCL config decoding
exec multiformat-app -c config.hcl
stdout '-p, --port\s+int\s+6000\s+● config config\.hcl'
stdout '--service-name\s+string\s+hcl-service\s+● config config\.hcl'

# 8. Strict validation typo suggestions (config-parse errors exit 1)
exit-status 1 multiformat-app -c typo.yaml
stderr 'unknown field "prt"'
stderr 'did you mean "port"\?'

# 9. Unsupported config file extension fails with a clean error (exit 1)
exit-status 1 multiformat-app -c config.xml
stderr 'unsupported config file format "\.xml"'

# 10. Duplicate JSON object keys are rejected (RFC 7493 strictness, exit 1)
exit-status 1 multiformat-app -c duplicate.json
stderr 'duplicate object member name "port"'

-- .env --
# Database and service defaults (variable expansion supported)
DB_HOST=localhost
DATABASE_URL=postgres://${DB_HOST}:5432/db
PORT=8000
SERVICE_NAME='local svc'
API_KEY=from-env

-- .env.local --
# Machine-local values, never committed to source control; API_KEY overrides .env
API_KEY=local-dev-key-42

-- config.json --
{
  "service_name": "json-service",
  "port": 3000,
  "max_workers": 8
}

-- config.yaml --
service_name: yaml-service
port: 4000
max_workers: 12

-- config.toml --
service_name = "toml-service"
port = 5000
max_workers = 16

-- config.hcl --
service_name = "hcl-service"
port = 6000
max_workers = 20

-- config.xml --
<port>7000</port>

-- typo.yaml --
prt: 8080

-- duplicate.json --
{
  "service_name": "dup",
  "port": 3000,
  "port": 4000
}
